recommendation.reason: Harbor-compatible agentic benchmark; expert-authored tasks, oracle-proven solvability and programmatic world-state checks make Real and Solid strong, while the new flag waives results.
risks: No pilot results, so difficulty and saturation are unknown.
Judge agreement with people is not reported.
Requires a Langfuse project and external API keys.

release.quote: A task is a Harbor-compatible directory. It holds `task.toml`, one instruction per turn, a seed for the world, `checks.yaml`, `mutations.yaml`, and an oracle.

redistribution_questions: Do the redistributed tasks include third-party fixtures, which keep their own licences and are only listed in THIRD_PARTY.md?
Is the CC BY 4.0 attribution string reproduced with any copy of the task data?
The wheel places task data under parallax/tasks/; does that shift the MIT code / CC BY 4.0 data boundary?
rights.quote: Code is licensed under [MIT](LICENSE). Task data under `tasks/` is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE-DATA). Third-party fixtures keep their own licences, which are listed in [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md).

tasks.quote: | `conformance` | 5 capability canaries | Checking a new adapter before it is compared |

verifier.full_credit: All task checks pass against the four parallax-owned evidence sources (service state, server call log, workspace snapshot, trusted test run); for browser tasks, the LLM judge grades the final page as correct.
verifier.quote: **Graded on world state, not self-report.** Checks read four things: the final service state, the server's own call log, the workspace snapshot and a trusted test run. What the harness says it did is kept for diagnosis only.

oracle.path: an oracle in each task directory (alongside `checks.yaml` and `mutations.yaml`)
oracle.command: `parallax check` (a task ships only when it passes)
oracle.quote: **Every task is proven gradeable.** A scripted oracle must pass every task. Two null agents must fail it: one claims success and does nothing, the other asks a question and does nothing. Seeded near-miss mutants must be caught.

network_or_api: Langfuse Cloud or self-hosted v4.59.0 or later
model provider endpoint through the metering proxy (OpenAI-wire, OpenRouter by default)
live websites for the browser sources live-web, online-mind2web and bu-bench
exceptions: Browser tasks need no seeded world: they drive a real browser and are graded by an LLM judge.
Browser tasks draw on live websites from live-web, online-mind2web and bu-bench.
Desktop tasks run seeded GTK apps in a private X11 device box and grade saved files; other harnesses are NA.
runtime.quote: You need Docker, Python 3.13, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and a Langfuse project (Langfuse Cloud, or self-hosted v4.59.0 or later).
